{{Quote|Here's an old Leffingite favorite, made fresh from juicy, Kessinnamon-spiced Almakian apples baked to perfection in a golden pom seed flour crust.|Menu for Dex's Diner|<ref name="DD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}.</ref>}}
The '''Leffingites''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almak/Legends|Almak]]. They were characterized by a tall, narrow head; a large, flat [[Nose/Legends|nose]] with two gaping nostrils; two large, fan-like [[Ear/Legends|ears]]; and large jaws from which protruded a smattering of small [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. Four [[Color/Legends|brown]] horns extended from above their [[Goggles/Legends|goggle]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]; two of these growths were relatively short, while two others were longer. The head extended at a perpendicular angle to the body and was covered in loose, wrinkled skin.

The [[all-Almakian apple pie]] was an example of Leffingite cuisine widely favored by the species. At least one Leffingite left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]; [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]] operated as a small-time crook in the gang run by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Leffingites later resisted the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] but were quelled in a [[Battle of Almak|battle]] during which the newly established [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government attacked them on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] with [[AT-series/Legends|AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Leffingite_dentition.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Leffingites exhibited several widely spaced teeth.]]
The Leffingites were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by [[ovine]] features.<ref name="CSWE II 248" /> The species' [[Bone/Legends|cranium]] was tall and flattened, with a rounded base that tapered to a pointed apogee. Four horns sprouted from the skull in two pairs; one pair was relatively short and grew from knobby growths between the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], while the second was longer and extended from behind the eyes. In at least one specimen, the horns were dull [[Color/Legends|brown]] in color. Two prominent [[Ear/Legends|ears]] extended outward from either side of the head; the auditory organs were narrow at the base and flared outward in a [[Tree/Legends|leaf]] shape before they narrowed to a point. Two smaller, rounded ear-like appendages adorned the top of the skull. The [[Nose/Legends|nose]] was long and tall; its wide base, perforated by two cavernous nostrils, narrowed to a thin bridge that extended to the top of the head. Eyes protruded from the face as two round orbs, pale in some specimens, that slanted downward from the top of the nose to the base of the ears; these sensory organs were covered by heavy lids.<ref name="AOTC" />

The [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], located immediately below the nose, was M-shaped, its midpoint located between the nostrils. The inside of the orifice was a grayish pink, and several sharp, white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] filled the maw. The dentition was such that two fangs grew downward from the center of the upper jaw, and two more each extended from the widest points of the upper and lower mandibles. These teeth protruded even when the mouth was shut. The face was covered in loose, wrinkled skin that hung from the jaw in strips that continued down the neck. In at least one Leffingite, the skin was a light brown. The species' head hung at a ninety-degree angle from the neck and torso, an arrangement that lent them a hunched posture.<ref name="AOTC" /> Leffingites were relatively short;<ref name="CSWE II 248" /> the one named [[Magaloof/Legends|Magaloof]] stood 1.4 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, for instance. The species had both [[Gender/Legends|males and females]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|magaloof|Magaloof}}</ref>

==Society and culture==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almak/Legends|Almak]] was the Leffingite [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="CSWE I 24">{{CSWECite|I|24|Almak}}</ref> At least some members of the species wore clothing. Leffingites were capable of learning to fly [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="AOTC" /> A favorite dish of the Almakian Leffingites was [[all-Almakian apple pie]], a desert made from the [[Almakian apple/Legends|Almakian apple]]. [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] offered the pastry at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 2.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DD" />

==History==
[[File:Almak_sector_and_environs.jpg|thumb|right|160px|The Leffingites hailed from Almak, in the Almak sector.]]
The Leffingites evolved on Almak,<ref name="CSWE I 24" /> a planet that became incorporated into the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] as part of the [[Almak sector/Legends|Almak sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].<ref name="EA 120">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> At some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Leffingites resisted the dominion of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the newly constituted galactic government, over their home [[Almak system/Legends|system]]. In retaliation, Imperial forces invaded Almac with [[AT-series/Legends|All Terrain]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]]. In the ensuing [[Battle of Almak|battle]], the Leffingite resistance was defeated. The results of the confrontation convinced the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Nahdonnis Praji]] that, while inelegant, AT walkers still served a purpose.<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>

==Leffingites in the galaxy==
{{Quote|What the&mdash;|Magaloof|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
At least one Leffingite emigrated into the greater galaxy: Magaloof, an individual who worked as a small-time crook on Coruscant, the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC 51">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> he stole an airspeeder in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and went on a joyride.<ref name="DB" /> Despite a near-crash with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was hurtling through Coruscant traffic hanging from a [[ASN-121/Legends|courier droid]],<ref name="AOTC" /> Magaloof landed the vehicle and sold it to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]]. The Leffingite became a regular member of Lo's gang, a capacity in which he came into contact with a [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] named [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]]. After a series of capers together, Med-Beq urged his Leffingite partner to rob a [[Unidentified jewelry store|jewelry store]] in Coruscant's [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]]. After the job, Magaloof ran into a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who identified himself as a [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] named [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]]; the man confiscated the stolen goods and let the Leffingite go with a warning. When Magaloof was unable to find Med-Beq and was arrested again shortly thereafter, he realized that he had been conned by his former partner. After a three-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] sentence in the [[CoCo Penitentiary]], Magaloof returned to Almak to start his life anew.<ref name="DB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The name of Magaloof's species was inspired by Lee Leffingwell, who had recently been elected to the Austin, Texas City Council when this submission was written. For whatever reason, his name stuck in my head and ended up in the entry. I've always wondered if Council Member Leffingwell is aware of his fame.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="NFCL">{{Blog|narbflick|7|Magaloof: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
The Leffingite character Magaloof appears in the [[2002]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Prequel trilogy|prequel]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> Although the character and his species both went unnamed in the movie, [[Gregory Walker]], writing under the screen name NarbFlick,<ref name="NFCL" /> first identified the species as part of his entry for Magaloof as part of the [[StarWars.com]] ''[[What's The Story?]]'' feature.<ref name="DB" /> Walker named the species for [[Wikipedia:Lee Leffingwell|Lee Leffingwell]], a politician whose campaign and election to the [[Wikipedia:Austin, Texas|Austin, Texas]], City Council in [[2005]] had placed the name Leffingwell in Walker's mind as he wrote his submission. Walker also established Almak as the species' homeworld; the name of the planet was simply a random assemblage of syllables that the author thought pleasant sounding.<ref name="NFCL" />
